messages:
maya: Heads up — weird micro-squall on the Embarcadero. Just saw a video of water splashing over the seawall near Pier 14. Anyone commuting by ferry or bike?
sam: ugh, I was planning to bike in. Is the 4th/King path flooded?
devin: Muni alert tweeted a detour for the 9 and 10s: https://twitter.com/sfmta_muni/status/xxxxx — says alternate routing around Folsom.
olivia: Ferry app shows delays + one vessel marked ‘returning to dock’. 20–30m backlog.
maya: thanks for the links. @lena you headed in from Oakland? Ferry or BART?
lena: Ferry got me this morning but I’m on the 2:15 that’s now delayed. Probably switch to BART if it’s >25m. Anyone want to carpool from Emeryville? I have room for 1.
jordan: My bike chain snapped on 3rd and Bryant from the spray, lol. If someone has a patch kit/allen key I’m nearby. :sweat_smile:
sam: @jordan I’ve got a multitool. Meet you in 5.
devin: For folks deciding whether to come in — office channel says we’re fine but the lower garage floods a bit on really high tides. Bring extra socks. :umbrella:
maya: note for evac logistics: if the piers go full splash it’s annoying but they said no shelter-in-place, just commute delays. ops-bot posted an incident for travel delays: INCIDENT-2026-03-23-42
olivia: quick poll — who’s still planning to come into the office today? React with :house: if yes, :house_with_garden: if no, :walking: if hybrid.
lena: :walking: — might come later after BART run clears.
jordan: :house_with_garden: — saving my wet shoes for home.
sam: :house: — already too far in. coffee at the kitchen for anyone who needs to dry things.
maya: @devin @olivia thanks for the commuter intel. if anyone needs a dry jacket or rideshare from 4th/King ping here.
ops-bot: FYI — Parking sensors report garage level 1 puddling. Recommended: avoid lower ramp until further notice.
devin: also PSA: if you lock your bike on the pier, tie a key to the frame or it might get... damp. True story.
olivia: LOL. okay staying home tomorrow is starting to look tempting.
maya: same. stay safe y'all. post updates if conditions change.
